sloka: यदि राम विनास्माभिर्गच्छेस्त्वं पुरुषोत्तम ।यमदण्डमिवोद्यम्य त्वया स्म विनिपातिताः ।। ७.१०८.२१ ॥
transliteration: yadi rāma vināsmābhirgacchestvaṁ puruṣottama ।yamadaṇḍamivodyamya tvayā sma vinipātitāḥ ।। 7.108.21 ॥

translations.english: "O Rama, best among men, if you depart without us, it would be as if we were struck down by you, like by the raised staff of Yama."
